scope.summary: Implement numeric edge-length authoring ops (CG-22, MD Change Length + Match 2D Pattern Measurements): change_edge_length(edge, target_cm, lock_curve_points) and match_edge_lengths(edge_a, edge_b, strategy) for numeric seam-length reconciliation between panels, complementing the SEAM_LENGTH_MATCH validator with an authoring-side fix per Section 13.6.
acceptance_criteria: change_edge_length scales/extends an edge to an exact target length with options: move end vertex vs scale-about-midpoint; lock_curve_points preserves curvature shape (MD lock option).
match_edge_lengths adjusts edge B to edge A's arc length (or meet-in-middle) reporting the applied delta; works across panels.
Both are edit_garment-reachable ops emitting draft events; SEAM_LENGTH_MATCH suggested_fix references them (typed fix action loop closure).
scope.risk_if_missed: Seam mismatch is the most common authoring error models make; without numeric reconciliation ops the validator can only complain, not offer a mechanical fix.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; GUI exposure rides the existing Tailor panels and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Pattern authoring, sewing, and arrangement

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT emits typed diagnostics through its owning command or job and inherits retention, health, and projection behavior from the shared diagnostics substrate.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
